perfil_raw.heading: Analista/Programador Senior D365F&O
perfil_raw.description:
Programador senior con más de 15 años de experiencia, enfocado a dar solución y resolver las dudas y problemas surgidos al plasmar la lógica de negocio del cliente en AX / D365FO. 
Experiencia en sectores de transporte, construcción, seguridad, producción, textil, alimenación.

Áreas:
- AX 2012
- D365FO
- DMF
- Integración de datos con software externo a través de :
   > Web Services
   > OData
   > Business Events
 
Tareas realizadas
- Análisis y realización de los requerimientos del cliente, asegurando que las soluciones propuestas cumplían con sus necesidades específicas.
- Realización de integraciones de datos E/S a través de Business Events, Web Services y OData, mejorando la interoperabilidad de los sistemas.
- Integraciones EDI
- Optimización de código en procesos lentos, resultando en una mejora significativa del rendimiento y la eficiencia operativa
- Formador de las nuevas incorporaciones a la empresa.
- Formador a los programadores de cliente.
- Marcar las pautas y gestionar las best practices de programación dentro de la empresa.
- Llevar equipos de programación.
- Technical leader.
- Gestión de evolutivos y mantenimiento de la aplicación del cliente.

sector.reasoning: The candidate's entire career centers on implementing, programming, integrating, and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics AX and D365F&O (ERP platforms) for diverse industry clients, focusing almost exclusively on ERP systems integration and enterprise-level software solutions. Key activities—business logic translation, data integration, client requirements analysis, technical leadership—are specific to enterprise business application development rather than general software/product development or pure IT consulting. Cross-sector client experience reflects ERP as a horizontal business solution; the technologies and terms used are unique to enterprise/ERP software contexts, not industry-specific automation or generic software development roles.

seniority.reasoning: The candidate's CURRENT focus is as a senior analyst/programmer specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365F&O) and earlier Dynamics AX. All recent and prior roles (spanning at least 12 consecutive years: 2013–2025) are directly relevant—their freelance and employment roles were all dedicated to AX/D365F&O solution design, development, integration, and technical leadership. There is no evidence of unrelated roles outside software engineering for enterprise Microsoft ERP products. The level of scope in projects (leading teams, technical mentorship, setting best practices, project owner for integrations, requirements analysis across industries) further confirms principal/expert level—not only doing, but organizing, shaping, and training the domain.

AX / D365FO.meaning: Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012) and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) enterprise resource planning (ERP) software platforms by Microsoft.

DMF.meaning: Data Management Framework (DMF), a toolset within Microsoft Dynamics AX/D365FO used for data integration, migration, and management.

Web Services.meaning: Machine-to-machine communication protocols for software integration, specifically SOAP/REST web services used for connecting ERP systems (Dynamics AX/D365FO) to other software.

OData.meaning: Open Data Protocol (OData), a RESTful API standard commonly used for integration and data exchange in enterprise software platforms like Dynamics 365 FO.

Business Events.meaning: Event-driven integration mechanism in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, used to trigger external processes or data flows based on business actions in the ERP.

Integraciones EDI.meaning: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integrations, digital exchange of business documents (invoices, orders, etc.) between ERP and other enterprise systems.

Optimización de código.meaning: Refactoring and improving software source code within enterprise/ERP solutions for performance and efficiency.

Formador.meaning: Trainer/mentor responsible for onboarding new developers and upskilling existing staff (both internally and on client side) in enterprise/ERP software technologies and best practices.

Best practices de programación.meaning: Established standards and guidelines for professional software development, specifically within enterprise/ERP programming teams.

Evolutivos y mantenimiento de la aplicac.meaning: Ongoing enhancements (continuous development) and maintenance of ERP/enterprise business software deployed at client organizations.

AX 2012.meaning: Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, a version of Microsoft’s ERP solution, used for enterprise business management processes.

D365FO.meaning: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, the current cloud-based ERP platform by Microsoft (abbreviated use throughout).

E/S.meaning: Entrada/Salida (Input/Output), referring to data flows between ERP system and external software during integrations.

Technical leader.meaning: Team lead responsible for guiding technical aspects of programming teams and projects, specifically in enterprise ERP software context.

.NET.meaning: Microsoft’s .NET (dotnet) development framework for building enterprise business applications, including integrations with Dynamics 365/AX.

This role directly leverages his seniority, sector focus, ERP expertise, leadership, and deep technical skill set.
